key_errors: CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries): Target "openvino_intel_gpu_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into another target. One may link only to INTERFACE, OBJECT, STATIC or SHARED libraries
root_cause: The Android CMake build fails during ov_generate_plugins_hpp() which calls ov_target_link_plugins() at plugins.cmake:325-327. This function tries to link plugin targets (openvino_auto_plugin, openvino_intel_gpu_plugin, etc.) into another target, but these are MODULE_LIBRARY type targets which CMake prohibits from being linked into other targets. The PR #37211 (GPU clang-tidy changes) does not touch CMake files, so this is a pre-existing infrastructure issue with the Android extra-modules configuration. The same failure was previously seen in run 31231244014 against PR #37304. This is a recurring CMake build configuration bug in the Android workflow unrelated to the PR content.
